project.name: Equilibrium
project.description: Browser-based isometric souls-like survival RPG — chunked open world, melee/ranged combat, soul meter, crafting, and lore-driven progression, built on PixiJS.

changelog: added: the soul system — soul is a resource earned from kills and spent on repair; bleed and leak drain you below an equilibrium point, and the game's title is now a literal mechanic
changed: enemies see and hear the world now — a 150° FOV cone, footstep and attack noise, arrows spotted at full range, and slimes that freeze then panic when they see a death
added: full day/night cycle — the world runs a 10-minute cycle of deep blue nights, warm golden dawn and dusk, and neutral days
changed: soul meter redesigned as crystallised light — a pointy-top hexagon rimmed by 12 glowing warm-white hexagons, a crown at full soul, and shattering shards when tiers are lost
added: focus healing — stand still while holding R to double your heal rate to 16 HP/s; the leak slows and you can finally climb past 91% health
changed: hotbar rebuilt from the ground up — four animated corner brackets on each slot that extend on hover and glow gold when equipped, over a soft pearl background
added: dash and time-freeze — Shift dashes you at 5× speed while invincible; Space freezes the world while you keep moving and attacking
added: changelog readable in-game — press C to open this very log in a soul-meter-styled panel, so every update shows up right in the game
